source.title: Every Asset Its Own Benchmark: Market-Neutral Alpha in Perpetual Futures
source.author: Dhanya MD

hypothesis: Standardizing each perpetual contract's momentum against its own trailing history removes cross-asset scale heterogeneity and improves market-neutral momentum robustness.

canonical.portfolio: long top quartile self-z / short bottom quartile self-z, 0.5 gross each side
canonical.execution: current open using only information through previous completed hour

fresh_confirmation: 2026 Binance monthly archive, locked unless canonical exploratory OOS Sharpe >1 and robustness gates pass
development_gate: canonical net Sharpe >0.70, positive return, at least 2/3 lookbacks positive
success_gate: canonical exploratory OOS net Sharpe >1, positive at 2x costs, >=2/3 neighbors positive, delay and BTC/ETH-exclusion positive, DSR reported against global trial count
limitations: 19 liquid Binance perpetuals; funding omitted from directional long-short PnL.
